To find out how much more money Jackie will have if she hires the accountant, we need to calculate the financial cost of doing the taxes herself and compare it to the cost of the accountant.

Step 1: Calculate the missed income from doing her taxes herself.
Jackie will miss 3 hours of freelance work, and she makes $35 per hour.
Missed income = 3 hours $\times$ $35/hour = $105.

Step 2: Identify the cost of hiring the accountant.
The accountant charges $90.

Step 3: Compare the two options.
By doing the taxes herself, she loses $105 in missed income. 
By hiring the accountant, she spends $90.

Step 4: Calculate the difference in money.
The difference = Missed income if she does it herself - Cost of the accountant
Difference = $105 - $90 = $15.

Jackie will have $15 more if she hires the accountant.

Final answer: 15
